claim: Facebook 2FA bug/loop (finally) resolved & full access regained!
summary: Facebook logged me out simultaneously on both my laptop and phone. I have gone through the whole ID verification thing and got an email with a code. The issue is when you try go on the response is go to your notifications on FB on your phone BUT i am logged out of FB on my phone. I get the same message if I try use the code to login on my phone.
